result.reason: The revision correctly makes the cap mutual and equal to the greater of trailing 12-month fees across the Agreement and all Order Forms or USD 1,000,000, while retaining the required uncapped carve-outs. However, it does not add the required mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages. It also leaves the payment-obligation exception limited to undisputed defined “Fees” for conforming Services; because “Fees” means only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, this does not clearly exclude all Customer payment obligations from the cap. The changes made are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial intent.
